public_rationale: The explicit 'all' is contradicted by Runway. Its November technical report and release document a substantial model-development business, including its own video foundation model and a publicly released robot-action model. Runway also integrates Claude and other third-party models, so it is relevant to the customer ecosystem in the surrounding passage. Those integrations support the narrower observation that application layers exist, but they do not make every AI startup basically a wrapper. No prevalence claim is substituted for Zitron's universal.
limitations: The term 'basically wrappers' requires an ordinary-language interpretation.
Model-development evidence comes from the company, with released weights and code described in its announcement.
This finding establishes a counterexample, not the proportion of startups that develop their own models.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: AI startups are basically wrappers for closed or open source models.

statement.excerpt: They’re all basically wrappers for closed or open source models.

from_speaker: for closed or open source models
our_interpretation: 'They' refers to AI startups in the preceding discussion. Preserve 'all' as a universal claim, not a claim about most startups.

The ordinary reading of 'basically wrappers' is that these businesses principally supply interfaces or applications around existing third-party models, without substantial model development of their own.
Using some third-party models or components does not by itself make an entire company basically a wrapper.

An established startup doing substantial model development is a counterexample even if it is atypical. A counterexample that also integrates external models addresses the narrower customer-oriented reading.

The statement describes an ongoing product state without a reporting period. Use the latest reportable calendar month to date, November 1–24, 2026, as the current snapshot; older documents are context only.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence covering the relevant startup population establishes that every company is principally an application or interface around third-party models, with no substantive counterexample.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one established AI startup in the relevant population demonstrably develops substantial models of its own as part of its business during the target period.
